data_facts_with_para.paragraph: In 2023, Tesla sold around 230,000 more cars than BYD. But the gap has been narrowing from 400,000 in 2022 and 600,000 in 2021.

data_facts_with_para.paragraph: However, the Chinese company stumbled in early 2024. It sold only 300,114 BEVs in the first quarter, down from the 525,409 it sold in the final three months of last year.

BYD sold 525,409 BEVs in the last quarter of 2023.

data_facts_with_para.paragraph: That drop was big enough for Tesla, which sold 386,810 BEVs in the same period, to retake its former position despite posting plunging sales.
